entities.name: Roman Catholic Diocese of Tôlagnaro

entities.summary: The Roman Catholic Diocese of Tolagnaro is a Latin suffragan diocese in the ecclesiastical province of Fort-Dauphin in Madagascar. It depends on the missionary Roman Congregation for the Evangelization of Peoples.
